subject: Qualification follow-up: POC prompt/log supply roadmap and owners
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Mercer <alex.mercer@lumogen.com>
Date: 2028-05-15T15:10:00-07:00
Subject: Qualification follow-up: POC prompt/log supply roadmap and owners

Hi Alex — great conversation earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned on the POC scope and evaluation handoff. I put owners and target dates inline so we can lock things down.

High-level POC objective
- Validate Redwood inference latency and cost at Lumogen's real-world prompt distribution and measure top-3 failure modes (hallucination, truncation, incorrect entity extraction).

Success criteria (customer-facing metrics)
- Latency: median end-to-end < 350ms for 95% of queries (90-token prompt/response)
- Cost: avg token cost improvement <= 30% vs current managed endpoint (as measured by Redwood analytics)
- Quality: pass rate >= 85% on Lumogen-defined correctness prompts (we'll use your labeled set)

Evaluation plan & data we need from Lumogen
1) Prompt set (required): ~5k production prompts representative of query mix. Format: CSV with columns [prompt_id, prompt_text, expected_response_short (optional), label_category].
2) Sample logs (recommended): 5000 anonymized request/response pairs with timestamps and response tokens for performance profiling.
3) Gold labels: 500 hand-labeled prompts covering priority categories for quality scoring (we can host a simple labeling sheet if helpful).

Timeline (proposed)
- By 2028-05-19: Lumogen uploads prompt CSV & 500 sample logs to S3 / Drive (owner: Lumogen)
- 2028-05-22: Redwood completes ingest + initial perf pass and shares first dashboard (owner: Redwood - Karthik)
- 2028-05-29: Quality eval on gold set, joint review call to discuss tradeoffs and quantization/throughput recommendations (owners: Karthik + Lumogen PM)

Ownership & operational asks
- Lumogen: provide prompt CSV and sample logs; confirm whether PII needs obfuscation, and share any contractual DUA notes (Dana in cc).
- Redwood: create dedicated S3 ingestion endpoint, run ingest validations, and produce evaluation dashboard + initial recommendations (config owners: Ben Carter and Monica Patel on our side).

Practical notes on delivery format
- Preferred upload: S3 (presigned PUT link) or Drive folder. File names: lumogen_prompt_batch_spec.xlsx (we attached a template) and lumogen_sample_prompt_log.csv.
- If you need a small anonymization script, we can provide a starter notebook (no PHI assumed in our template).

Attachments: prompt batch template (lumogen_prompt_batch_spec.xlsx) + sample log CSV.

Next steps
- Alex: confirm by EOD Tuesday that S3/Drive upload is feasible + any legal gating (Dana).
- Karthik: I will provision an ingest queue and share presigned links once you confirm the upload location.

Thanks — excited to get this moving.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Enterprise Solutions
Redwood Inference

From: Alex Mercer <alex.mercer@lumogen.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Dana Lee <dana.legal@lumogen.com>
Date: 2028-05-15T18:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Qualification follow-up: POC prompt/log supply roadmap and owners

Thanks for the clear plan, Karthik — appreciated. Dana and I reviewed the ask and we can deliver the prompt CSV and sample logs. A few clarifications: 

- Upload: S3 is preferred. We can provision a tenant bucket and give Redwood a presigned PUT.
- Anonymization: logs contain only user IDs (internal IDs) and free-text. We will replace user IDs with hashed tokens before sending; please confirm that preserves the columns you need.
- Legal: Dana is checking DUA language; any standard Redwood DPA/DUA example you can share will help move faster.

Timeline:
- 2028-05-19: Lumogen will upload the prompt CSV and 500 sample logs to the S3 bucket (target).
- 2028-05-23: We can have the first joint review call if Redwood can complete the ingest by then.

We will attach a small sample file here for format sanity check (sample attached). Also, Ben/Monica — feel free to weigh in on ingestion constraints or any required schema enforcement.

Alex
Product Lead, Lumogen

Attachments referenced: lumogen_sample_prompt_log.csv

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-05-16T08:05:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Qualification follow-up: POC prompt/log supply roadmap and owners

Folks — forwarding Lumogen confirmation. Action items for our team: 

1) Ben: please provision an S3 ingest endpoint (tenant bucket) and generate presigned PUTs for Lumogen. Make sure bucket lifecycle is set to 90 days and encryption (SSE-KMS) is enabled.
2) Monica: once Ben confirms the presigned links, let's run the schema validator (I attached the template) and queue the batch for the ingest pipeline. Expect initial perf pass by 2028-05-22.
3) Ben/Monica: flag any legal or security blockers; Dana (Lumogen legal) is cc'd on the external thread.

I attached the prompt batch template and the sample that Alex sent.

Thanks — I'll update HubSpot with the new milestone (upload scheduled 2028-05-19) and create the 05/23 review meeting invite.

-Karthik

Attachments referenced: lumogen_prompt_batch_spec.xlsx, lumogen_sample_prompt_log.csv

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>

- Create bucket redwood-lumogen-poc-202805 (SSE-KMS, block public access).
- Generate presigned PUT URLs and drop them into the shared Drive folder + email Alex directly with instructions.
